_comment: Venue -> district, for venues whose `area` string never names its district.
Read by BOTH scripts/fetch_events.py (_slugify_matches) and js/radar.js
(districtOf) so the generated district pages and the homepage radar always
agree. Keys are matched with _venue_key()/_venueKey() -- the same
punctuation-insensitive form venue-aliases.json uses -- so '&' vs 'and',
apostrophes and a trailing ' - TX' all fold together. Keys here must
already be in that form (lowercase, '&' spelled 'and', no apostrophes).
WHY THIS EXISTS: districts were resolved purely by substring-matching the
free-text `area` field ('deep ellum' in 'Trees, Deep Ellum, Dallas'). Most
ticketing rows are just 'Venue, City', so a venue whose NAME does not
contain its district never matched. On 2026-08-27 that left 230 of 635
events (36%) in no district at all, and six district pages -- Downtown
Dallas, Arts District, Uptown, Design District, Stockyards, Grapevine --
serving nothing but boilerplate and nav. Google had all of them parked in
'Discovered - currently not indexed', which is what a page with no unique
content earns.
WHY THIS IS THE SAFE FIX: the substring match still runs FIRST and is
unchanged, so nothing that matched before can move. This table is only
consulted when the old path returned nothing -- it is purely additive.
Values are checked against DISTRICTS at build time, so a typo'd slug fails
the nightly run loudly instead of silently dropping a venue.
ONLY add a venue you can place. A wrong district is worse than none: it
sends someone to the wrong side of town. Leave a venue out and it still
appears on /tonight/, its own /venue/ page and its city hub -- it just
does not claim a district.
TWO GROUPINGS TO KNOW ABOUT: DISTRICTS (js/data.js) has no Fair Park and no
Cedars entry, and adding one means recomputing the radar's hand-tuned label
positions. Both sit within ~2 miles of downtown, so they are filed under
downtown-dallas for now:
Fair Park  - music hall at fair park, club 909 ..., dos equis pavilion,
riverfront jazz fest at fair park
The Cedars - south side ballroom, gilleys dallas, the cedars,
longhorn ballroom and backyard amphitheater
Split them out here first if either district is ever added.
